scenes.stage_direction: Victor's commands meet increasingly specific questions he cannot answer. His uncertainty must not be played as proof Ethan is safe.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: I understand that fear. I need her to understand that I am not the person she should hide him from.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: She will accept an independent visitor through an agreed channel.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: Then find someone who will look at Ethan, not just at the papers.

metadata.evidence_summary: The listed office and the care location are distinct.
